## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the contribution policy.
- [ ] Any substantial API, dependency, or third-party work was
      discussed with maintainers before implementation.
- [ ] Generated clients, models, types, pinned specifications, and generation
      sources are unchanged, unless this is a maintainer-led generation update.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests when applicable.
- [ ] Tests are deterministic and credential-free and cannot place live orders;
      trading examples default to paper trading and fixtures use synthetic data.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Applicable typecheck, lint, test, build, package, documentation, and
      generation checks pass.
- [ ] A Changeset is included, or this change has no SDK-consumer-facing impact.
- [ ] No credentials, account data, or other secrets are included.
- [ ] Any provider-specific integration or promotional contribution has written
      Alpaca approval confirmed by repository maintainers.
